text: We use the simple present tense to talk or write about things that happen all the time or a number of times.Pay attention, when the subject is in first person, we use the basic form of the verb.When the subject is the third person singular, the verb becomes the first person singular.When the subject is the third person singular, the verb becomes the third singular.Wendy sometimes makes phone calls to her clients, but she works on her computer every day.Here, sometimes is an adverb, and every day is an adverbial phrase of frequency.We often use adverbs and adverbial phrases of frequency to tell how often things happen.Adverbs usually come before the main verb.Adverbial phrases often come at the end or the beginning of a sentence.Let's read a short article about Wendy's school life.She gets up at six.She puts on her school uniform.She usually achieves eight grades in all her subjects.She sometimes attends clubs after school.She enjoys her school life.So, don't forget to add S to verbs after he, she, it.We add ES to verbs that end in S, X, CH, or SH.We also add ES to verbs like go and do.Some verbs end in N consonant and Y.Then we drop the Y and add IES.Does Wendy need to spend much time on lessons?No, she doesn't need to spend much time on lessons.Doesn't need is the negative form of needs.Now, please read these sentences and find out if there are any mistakes in them.If there are any mistakes, please correct them.Please take out your worksheet and finish task one.Thank you for watching.Have you finished?Now, let's check the answers.Wendy is the third person singular, so we should add S to the verb achieve.Starting is the verb ending in a consonant and Y.So, we should drop the Y and add IES.The negative form of spends should be doesn't spend.We should use a basic form of a verb in a yes or no question.Once a week is an adverbial phrase of frequency.It often comes at the beginning or at the end of the sentence.Here is a short passage about Wendy's business.Please take out your worksheet and finish task two.Please take out your worksheet and finish task three.有答案吗?现在,让我们检查一下。Wendy写的电子游戏,她的父母和兄弟在她的生意中工作。驾驶员每天早上带她去学习。她经常在学习前通过电子游戏给客户做电子游戏。她在晚饭前完成了她的家务。她在晚饭后与父母商量生意。晚饭后,她去她的办公室,并继续工作。她总是晚上11点30分。这里有四个问题关于Wendy。请考虑和选择在哪个情况下,Wendy应该用简单的 present tense。问题一,Wendy正在与她的朋友谈恋爱。问题二,Wendy想写一封信给她的朋友,告诉他她的习惯和兴趣。问题三,Wendy正在与她的朋友谈恋爱。问题四,Wendy正在与她的朋友谈恋爱。在哪个情况下,她应该用简单的present tense。问题五,Wendy想写一封信给她的朋友,告诉他她的习惯和兴趣。问题六,Wendy正在与她的朋友谈恋爱。问题七,Wendy正在与她的朋友谈恋爱。问题八,Wendy正在与她的朋友谈恋爱。A letter to a pen friend to tell him about her habits and hobbies.She should use the simple present tense in this case.Because habits and hobbies are the things that happen all the time or a number of times.Now suppose you are talking with your friend about Wendy.She's very curious about her and asks you some questions.Here are the questions she asks.Let's read them.How much time does she spend on writing computer games?What kind of games does she write?What does she usually do in her spare time?How does she balance her work and play?What does she think of being a whiskit?We know these words in the box are question words.When we use question words to ask for information,we put the helping verbs in front of the subjects.当用特殊疑问词询问信息的时候,我们要把助动词提到主语的前面。Wendy is good at studying and her business is quite successful.She also relaxes herself by doing a lot of after school activities.Look, what does Wendy do after school?She plays basketball after school.Who does she play basketball with?She plays it with her friends.How often does she play it?She plays it twice a week.How does she play it?She plays it very well.Now, please choose one of the pictures and talk about Wendy's after school activities with your partner.Wendy is good at studying and playing basketball.She plays it well.She goes there with her friends.How often does she go to the library?She goes there twice a week.What does she do there?She usually reads books and magazines.What kind of books is her favorite?She likes detective stories best.Wendy is so popular among the students that many of them want to know her secrets to success.David, a journalist from Garden Daily, is interviewing her.Please read the interview and find out what secrets Wendy shares with David.Please take out your worksheet and finish task 3.Let's check.She balances work and playing.She relaxes herself by playing basketball and practices the violin.She plays the piano.She plays the violin.She gets on well with her teachers and classmates.She assists them when they are in need.Have you got all the secrets Wendy shares with us?Now make a speech to introduce Wendy to the students in Garden School.You can evaluate your speech with the checklist.And find out if she uses the simple present tense, other verbs, and other verb phrases of frequency properly in her speech.Hello, everyone.I'm so honored to introduce Wendy, a whiskey to you.As a student and business girl, she balances her work and play very well.Although she is busy with her study and work, she always finds time to relax herself.She plays basketball with her classmates after school twice a week.Once a week, she practices playing the violin.She is ready to assist them when they turn to her for help.By helping them, she improves herself.The secrets to her success are that she not only manages time very well, but also has a good relationship with her teachers and classmates.She did a very good job.She uses the simple present tense, other verbs, and other verb phrases of frequency correctly in her speech.Although people call Wendy a whiskey, she thinks she is an ordinary kid.You may think you are ordinary kids, but you are whiskey in someone's eyes.Who is another whiskey in your eyes?Why do you think he or she is a whiskey in your eyes?Please think it over and get ready to share your ideas.现在让我们分享David的想法雖然她不擅長學習,但她仍然是一個有很多光芒的人。她總是準備幫助別人,並分享一切。當我們感到難過時,她總是給予我們建議。她還擅長跳舞,而且充滿信心在學校上表演天才表演。今天是家庭工作。這就是今天的課程結束。
